title: Leonxlnx/earshot
why_read: A CPU-only open-source tool giving AI coding agents the ability to listen to and produce audio feedback, a creative niche addition to the agentic coding tool ecosystem.
analysis: Earshot gives AI coding agents auditory capabilities, letting them 'hear' and generate sound, likely for use cases like audio-based code review, alerts, or accessibility feedback during automated coding sessions. Being CPU-only suggests it's designed for lightweight, accessible deployment without requiring a GPU, which could matter for broader adoption. This is a niche but creative tool in the growing ecosystem of agentic developer tools that go beyond text-only interaction. It's unclear from the description alone how mature or widely useful the audio features actually are in practice.
